Senses.Explanation: The lineage vehicle is the publicly transmitted way or authority of the ancestral lineage. In encounter records, unnamed monks ask masters for its highest principle or how its higher reach is proclaimed; Huangbo Xiyun asks Baizhang Huaihai how it has been shown to people from the past onward. Chengtian Zong later comments that the lineage vehicle is not easy to support. The phrase therefore names what is inherited, displayed, questioned, and sustained in the lineage rather than a literal conveyance.

Senses.Explanation: A lineage master: the designation for someone presented or judged in relation to the Chan ancestral line. The term occurs 1,445 times in 257 allowlisted texts. Daowu Wuzhen gives a direct role statement: “As for a lineage master, he takes away the poor child's pearl sewn in his clothes and examines the accomplished person's viewpoint” (夫宗師者，奪貧子之衣珠，究達人之見處). Dahui Zonggao says that a lineage master decides right and wrong and must open people's eyes rather than rely only on blind cangues and sightless blows (大凡宗師決斷是非。要得開人眼目。不可一向盲枷瞎棒). Zhaozhou Congshen says a lineage master must meet people with the fundamental matter. Yuanwu Keqin likewise says the lineage-master household must teach a person through, even at the cost of injuring hand and blade when the person does not understand (宗師家為人須為教徹). Yuanwu calls Zhaozhou Congshen “a great-handed lineage master” (大手宗師), saying that Zhaozhou does not discuss mystery, marvel, occasion, or object but meets people with the fundamental matter. He also calls Dongshan Shouchu, Zhimen Guangzuo, Deshan Yuanming, and Xianglin Chengyuan “great lineage masters” (皆為大宗師). The label can be withheld or mocked: Xuedou Chongxian says of an inadequate answer, “calling oneself a lineage master like this and wanting to open the eyes of humans and gods—only in the donkey year” (如此自稱宗師，欲開人天眼目，驢年去). The noun thus works as a title and appraisal tied to public responsibilities, and as a rebuke when a claimant does not meet them.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X81/X81n1568.xml). Strict Lineage of the Five Lamps (Vols. 10–25) (五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷)): the Baizhang Daoheng section says “the master presented a verse” and thereby assigns “you now wish to comprehend and unite the purport” to Baizhang Daoheng’s verse.

Senses.Explanation: The defining purport is the point by which a lineage or house is fixed, handed on, recognized, or publicly demanded. The Bodhidharma transmission formula says that the robe is given outwardly “to establish the purport” (外付袈裟，以定宗旨); later records quote that formula rather than treating every quotation as a fresh Bodhidharma event. Biography uses the same word for what a person awakened to—“he attained insight into Huanglong’s purport” (得悟黃龍宗旨). In interview speech an unnamed monk says that raising the teaching banner and establishing the purport are his ordinary fare (建法幢、立宗旨者，是和尚尋常茶飯). Xu Fang’s preface says a collected record “gathered the great completion and established the purport” (乃集大成、乃定宗旨), while a verse challenges someone wishing to comprehend and unite the purport. These rows make the term the defining or transmitted point of a named teaching line, text, or public claim; uttered formulas, compiler biography, preface, and test verse retain their separate actors.

Senses.Explanation: The essential point of the school is what Chan records say named figures grasps, verifies, or raises in public exchange; it names the governing point of a house rather than a detachable explanatory proposition. Lamp histories use the compound in biographies: Daqianshan Congxi thoroughly understands the school's essential point, Yunmen Wenyan accords with it after hearing Xuefeng answer, and other abbots are praised for verifying or raising it. The institutional account of Baizhang's hall makes guest-and-host questioning publicly stimulate the essential point. These narrations show what the records count as its observable setting, but they do not supply one abstract sentence that exhausts it.

Senses.Explanation: The Chan lineage tradition is the inherited school domain invoked when speakers distinguish its characteristic questions, ways, vocabulary, or business from other forms of exposition. The phrase can refer broadly to the tradition or narrowly to what counts within its gate. A book title containing the graphs is not by itself evidence for this common-noun use.

AlternateTargets: the public style of a Chan house
Senses.Explanation: The lineage's house style: the recognizable way a Chan house carries and displays its inheritance. Public interviews repeatedly pair it with the song the named respondent sings and ask from whom it descends. Linji Yixuan answers by recalling his three beatings under Huangbo Xiyun; Xingyang Guijing points to Shaoshi, Shoushan Shengnian to a personal transmission there, Baizhang Zhiying to an image held in the palm, and Qingshan Hao to a charge received at Vulture Peak and enacted at Wenshui. Konggu Daocheng speaks of fanning this style until plants come alive, Juelang Dasheng asks supporters to sustain it together, and Guxue Zhe says it will greatly flourish. Chan bends ordinary school custom into an inheritance whose validity is made public in answers and conduct.
Senses.Note: Frozen-corpus concordance: 2,159 exact hits in 337 files and 331 works. One referent covers inheritance, activation, support, and flourishing; response differences are lineage claims, not separate senses.

Senses.Explanation: Take a little attainment as sufficient diagnoses the mistake of treating partial realization as completion. Zihu Lizong calls it a corrupting obstacle; later instructions connect it with refusal to advance, careless antinomian claims, premature teaching, or satisfaction with an initial opening. Zhang Jiucheng explicitly says he fears this fault.

Senses.Explanation: An interview expression paired with 'darkness within brightness.' Asked for brightness within darkness, one retained address answers, 'white clouds envelop the moonlight'; asked for the reverse, he answers, 'green bamboo dances in the clear wind.' Parallel interviews give different paired answers and then ask how far brightness and darkness are apart.
